card.name: Unix shell listings and scattered text
card.fires_on: Mostly words and digits inside Unix command-line output, such as ls -l listings, file names and password prompts. It also fires on a few unrelated spots in medical disclaimer text.

modes.label: Shell output
modes.description: Names, numbers or spaces in terminal listings after commands like ls or passwd.
